displayName: OCI-AI-VEC-002: AI — Vector DB — Weaviate Tenant Data Isolation Failure
description:
Detects cross-tenant data access in Weaviate vector database

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — vector db — weaviate tenant data isolation fa

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_vec_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%vector%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%weaviate%') AND "value" > 0
